description: Use this when the person likes a look and wants to keep it, or wants their saved look on clips. The same saved templates as the Slice editor's Saved styles. kind: style (the caption look with logo, framing, stacking and caption rules; "setup" also keeps the clip's shape, layout, hook title look and B-roll look), title (a hook title style), audio_brand (the brand template every new audio episode opens in), layout (the starting layout for whole videos), broll_look (a saved Un-Stock look for B-roll) and visual_cut (a storyboard's saved style). save: from_clip (its current look) or settings (style: the set_caption_style fields, e.g. {"style":"bold-punch","color":"#ffffff","font":"Anton"}; title: {"template","colour","mark_colour","font_scale","align"}; broll_look: Un-Stock {"preset"?, "settings"}), with a name. list: every template with its id, kind and which is the default. get: one in full. apply: id to clip_id, clip_ids or an episode_id's clips: no render, one undoable change per clip (undo_edit). new_uploads true makes it the default for new uploads; only when the person asks for that. rename: id and name. delete: call once to get a confirm token and a question; ask the person, then call again with confirm.

confirm.description: delete: the token the first delete call gave, once the person has said yes.

episode_id.description: apply: every clip of this episode.

from_clip.description: save: the clip whose current look to keep (a clip id, or a storyboard's clip for visual_cut).

from_video.description: save kind layout: the whole video whose layout to keep.

id.description: A template id as list gives it (e.g. "style:<uuid>", "title:<id>", "audio_brand").

kind.description: For save and list. Not needed with an id from list.

new_uploads.description: apply or save: true makes it the default for new uploads (only when the person asks); false stops that.

replace.description: save: overwrite a template of the same name.

settings.description: save without a clip: the look itself (see the description).

name: templates
title: Saved templates: save, list, apply, rename, delete
